label: KGhost
description: Race against a ghost on your Karoo: a fixed-pace Ghost Pace or your own past self on a route, stitched into one continuous ghost. Shows the live time/distance gap on graphical and numeric data fields and draws the ghost's position on the map. Records each ride automatically and can import GPX/FIT ghosts dropped in /sdcard/KGhost. Keeps estimating during GPS dropouts. Beta version, use with care.
releaseNotes: First Release (Beta Release). Route position now comes from the Karoo's own map-matching (loop- and reroute-safe). Fair start: the race begins when you start riding, not while you wait for a GPS lock. Segment entry AND exit in-ride alerts (nearby stretches don't double-alert). Storage access is re-read without restarting after you grant it. Clearer storage-permission notice. Rebrand to KGhost, imperial-unit fixes and es-ES localization.
